notes.title: REVEALED: Chinese & French! Russian Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Chinese & French Localization Are Here! [/h1]
[h1]Russian is Coming Very Soon![/h1]

[h2]As well as small bug fixes & quality of life improvements already added in Version 1.0.8[/h2]

[h3]Hello again, peeps![/h3]

Yet another update for [b]Alan Sharp - Chapter 0: Prologue[/b]. Like we promised, we will continue updating and improving the gameplay experience for every horror & puzzle fan! We've watched your videos, your livestreams, checked the comments and taken notes.

In this [b]Update Version 1.0.8[/b], we are happy to [b]announce[/b] that:
[h3][b]2 New Languages[/b][/h3] have been added to the game, including a [b]third one[/b] which is well underway.
Get your [b]Chinese[/b] & [b]French[/b] Horror Mates and bring them into the mysterious world of Alan Sharp.
Oh, we haven't forgotten about you [b]Russian fans[/b]! The Russian Localization is being worked on as we write this Announcement!

[h3]Besides the 2 New Languages Added, we also focused on suggestions, small bugs and quality of life improvements[/h3], including:

[list]
[*] Collision fixes & tweaks throughout all the levels
[*] Fixed the widget saying "Bold cutter" instead of "Bolt Cutter"
[*] Red lights intensity in the last level increased for better player guidance, as well as added another light where we considered it would be helpful for players to navigate.
[*] Fixed the drawer in the Library which wasn't "closable" and added to the Save System. Although not a bug, we believe it is a nice quality of life touch to the game.
[*] Fixed every single drawer which pushed you away when standing too close to it
[*] Added a widget to explain why Sam suddenly reacted with a "mad" speech at particular moments. Although there were streamers who noticed the reason, many were quite confused. We believe this particular on-screen widget would clear up the mystery :)
[*] Lowered the end credits music volume
[*] Localization fixes across all languages where particular Journal entries weren't written in the selected language.
[/list]

[h2]Your suggestions and opinion matter![/h2] 

They're the driving force that led Alan Sharp all this way and we'll continue to improve it to provide you an amazing, immersive experience!

notes.title: Large Update focused on Bugs, Glitches & Gameplay Issues
notes.content:
[b]Just Amazing[/b], [b]You guys[/b] who reached out to us via e-mail, or the [b]Streamers[/b] who ended up on a potential issue - again, you [b]help us improve Alan Sharp[/b] and make it better, more engaging and more fun to play! ːsteamhappyː

[h2]This would be a large update [b]focused on bugs, glitches, game crashers and some quality of life[/b] we've managed to finish in the past couple of days. Check it out![/h2]

[h3][b][Patch Notes][/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Sam seen standing in the end - fixed
[*] Grammatical errors in some items fixed
[*] Added some additional "clues" (helpers) to guide players while solving the Regan case in the mansion.
[*] A sound cue added in the Asylum
[*] Tweaking the door jumpscare camera control
[*] Reduced the sound of "Journal Updated" when starting the final level of Chapter 0.
[*] Fixed issues with the save system
[*] Pick up sound of the statue on the bar - volume lowered
[*] Fixed the overlap speech in the Asylum
[*] Invisible walls added in the Artifact scene where you were able to pass through a wall to the living room. Added extra invisible wall to prevent going to basement and confuse players
[*] Added lighting helpers to prevent players wandering aimlessly around the mansion
[*] Weapon un-hidden on the AI
[*] Removed the hovering weapon glitch in Sewers
[*] Fixed the standing black figure in the hidden cutscene
[*] Removed "trace of blood" which got stuck on the screen during cutscene
[*] A lot of optimization, removal of unecessary objects and deactivation of several empty drawers and cabinets which confused players and made them open every single one of them
[*] Journal Entry fixes
[*] Maze Puzzle issue fixed which, although rarely, caused the pin to go out of the maze.
[*] Added auto-wrap function on the Journal Entries
[*] Voice-recorder removed once you get back to Regan Manor.
[*] Phone ringing removed which caused some players to think it was a guide for further progression.
[*] Fixed doctor in Save System
[*] A bug which locked all doors during Continue game - fixed
[*] Game crasher on cabin puzzle with the letters fixed
[*] 4 drawings counting issue in Alan's home fixed
[*] Locker & Locker System removed - although it was presented as an Easter Egg, we do not think it would be suitable mechanic for our game.
[*] Fixed the issue where you can double-click the gun in the memory lane and cause the cutscene all over again
[*] Fixed crouch places issue
[*] Fixed the navmesh space of the AI which prevented it to go through doors or narrow spaces.
[/list]


[h2]For the [b]Next Update in a few days[/b], we'll be [b]focusing on Quality of Life[/b] things and [b]additional localization[/b]. [/h2]

If you stumble upon any bug or issue, feel free to reach us via [b]Social Media[/b] of your desire (we're active on [url=https://www.facebook.com/AlanSharpGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/AlanSharpGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/alansharpgame/]Instagram[/url]) or via the [b]Contact Form on our [url=https://www.alansharpgame.com]website[/url][/b] and we'll gladly add it to the list.

We would also love to mention a [b]HUGE Surprise[/b] in the following days for [b]You and Your Friends[/b]! 
Stay tuned! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Huge Update - Bug Fixes & Glitches
notes.content:
Before we start addressing this update, we would [b]LOVE[/b] to thank all of you guys who played Alan Sharp! We [b]carefully watched[/b] every stream/video we could come across, whether it's live or pre-recorded on Youtube or Twitch.

We [b]analyzed[/b] every single moment, writing down things which [b]felt hard, bothered you, potential bugs and issues, suggestions, audience & content creator feedback[/b] - everything we could come across to make Alan Sharp as best as possible for all detective, horror fans and lovers of deep, immersive stories.

The number of players who already got the game in these two days is... [b]astonishing[/b]. And seeing streamers/players immersed in the story itself was a dream come true. [b]Thank you![/b]

Now, back to the [b]UPDATE[/b] ːsteamhappyː
We noticed some [b]concerning issues[/b] which prevented some players from continuing the game at particular points, so those became our [b]first top priority[/b] for this next patch.

[b]Here are the things that will not bother you anymore, peeps! A good bug is a dead bug *demonic grin:[/b]

1. The Doctor not working in the asylum level after you exit and click continue - save system issues fixed
2. The pump puzzle bugging
3. The pump spawning a double cinematic and game crashing
4. Huge inventory fix which previously deleted items randomly
5. Removed a widget in police station
6. Fixed the "gun" at "Empty level" to prevent spam and cause a glitch
7. Fixed several journal entries
8. Removed a floating lamp light in Regan Manor
9. Increased blocking volume at the library which caused players to get stuck when opening the drawer.
10. Removed a trigger box saying "Not available in this demo"
11. Rotation fix for Last Checkpoint after you get caught - caused players to get confused when Sam was looking in the dark.
12. Fixed a bug which caused players to light up item before a puzzle is solved.
13. Huge graphical optimization for smoother gameplay and higher FPS.

[b]Note:[/b] A few more "visual" things will be fixed first things in the morning tomorrow, although they won't affect your gameplay and get you stuck.
With the morning update, we'll also [b]change the version in the main menu, so do not get confused when you see version 1.0.5 still there with game's update.[/b]

Also, we received [b]a lot of questions regarding future chapters[/b]. Soon, we'll post another announcement which [b]thoroughly describes how future chapters will be released[/b] to clear out any misunderstanding and confusion you might have.

As always, we'll continue to watch your videos, analyze your feedback, take into consideration your opinions and ideas and we'll do our best to [b]smash any hidden bugs coming down the road[/b] :))

notes.title: The Suspect System [Coming in Chapter 1]
notes.content:
[h1]Hey peeps![/h1] ːsteamhappyː

A whole system across the game, [b]starting from Chapter 1[/b]. It features high [b]replayability[/b], a lot of [b]Player Choices[/b] throughout the entire game and [b]Multiple Endings[/b]. It's main focus is critical thinking, logical consideration and player choice of a suspect based on acquired evidence.

[h3][b]But, first of all, our dear peeps, Merry Christmas! 
May 2021 year be a groundbreaking one for you,
making all your dreams come true![/b][/h3] ːcsgo_explosionː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37859401/c51b348154846a22fb46fc732c205359ee4e22ba.jpg[/img]

Here, at Mystive Studios, we just started an awesome game mechanic, a new feature which will definitely change the overall feel and gameplay of "Alan Sharp". After brainstorming countless ideas on how we could improve and provide better gameplay experience with every coming chapter, we came up with the idea we called 

[h2][b]The Suspect System[/b][/h2]

After careful consideration, we realized that it would drastically change everything, providing a lot of [b]Replayability[/b], a lot of [b]Player Choices[/b] and [b]Multiple Endings[/b]. 

[h2]Let's dive a little deeper into what The Suspect System really means!
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37859401/d4c21202a8dd3dfad13ece85e97588e00aa21f5f.png[/img]

The Suspect System represents our unique contribution to the [b]Psychological/Survival Horror[/b] genre. It did not take long to realize that it would become the most basic core mechanic of Alan Sharp which will lead the entire progress of the players.

Being also a [b]Detective/Mystery Game[/b], Alan Sharp needed some kind of a mechanic which would make players [b]"feel" like detectives[/b], to know that their thinking, consideration, analysis of evidence actually affects the world around them and the overall gameplay. That's how this Suspect System of Alan Sharp was born.

[h2][b]How does it work?[/b][/h2]

Like we previously mentioned, Alan Sharp will feature approximately 4 hours of gameplay [b]per each Chapter[/b]. Currently, there are 4 planned Chapters of the overall storyline ([b]although this might change[/b]).

Being heavily based on dialogue choices and unveiling the truth via interaction with other characters in Beggers Hole, there will be [b]particular moments when the player must make a decision[/b]. 
The system takes into consideration all characters the player met until that particular moment and writes them down in the Journal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37859401/9146489877100f407a5433f255bd546278b5f5b0.jpg[/img]

In these [b]critical moments[/b], the player will have to make a decision and add [b]a tick[/b] to a particular name (character) he thinks it is a suspect in the Regans' Case. The choice will be fully on the player, who should critically analyze the evidence, consider everything he uncovered so far and make the decision.

[h3]These Suspect System moments will [b]usually occur[/b] after important reveals such as some character dialogue, or a clue found around the world.[/h3]

In the last Chapter, the [b]Suspect System will check the analysis of the player throughout the entire game[/b] and based on the character who has the most "ticks" ([b]suspect points[/b]), it will provide a [b]different ending[/b] where that character will be arrested. Remember, only one is the true villain and the wrong choices might put an innocent soul into jail :))

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37859401/150d0b42cca93de891f0e86339e16929b77838ab.png[/img]

Having [b]The Suspect System[/b] on the front lines, these are the [b]3 Most Important Things[/b] that it would be affected by it:

[b]Replayability[/b] - The suspect system is present throughout the entire game
[b]Player Choice[/b] - A fully-free player choice by adding ticks depending on his opinion, his analysis of evidence and encounters.
[b]Multiple Endings[/b] - Basically, there will be as much ending as there are characters in the Suspect System.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37859401/13c107dafdda5de34ed90799c8e4f9e6ef9a1070.jpg[/img]

[h2]Let us hear your thoughts in the comments how you like it! We believe that it would be an awesome addition to the evolving open world of Alan Sharp! [/h2]

notes.title: Alan Sharp Demo Key Takeaways
notes.content:
Hello guys (and girls)! The Steam Summer Festival is over. We would like to share with you what we have learned through the demo of Alan Sharp thanks to your feedback and what's coming next.

Key takeaways from Alan Sharp Demo:

[list]
[*]  Improving the settings - Already on it, boys!
[*]  Adding additional features to the Journal System - we already have an idea and are working on it.
[*]  Polishing animations of characters
[*]  Voice actors recordings overhaul
[*]  Improve the overall atmosphere and lightning of the game (we already pushed some updates during the demo and will continue working on it)
[/list]

What else will be different in the main game in comparison with the Demo?

[list]
[*]  Survive - The Demo was focused around the main house which contained puzzles and psychological horror elements. The Main Game will also feature survival elements.
[*]  Semi-open world - Alan Sharp will feature Beggers Hole (town), its beach, and a forest to explore. But, beware of the danger in the dark.
[*]  Steam Achievements - We don't think we need to say anything more.
[*]  A lot of NPCs - after all, Alan Sharp is a detective game and detectives need witnesses.
[/list]

And a [b]lot more systems[/b] that we are yet to reveal!

Follow us on [b]Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Discord[/b] or [b]subscribe[/b] on our Website to keep up with the latest updates.

notes.title: Update: Your opinion matters
notes.content:
Hey there guys! Thank you everyone for playing Alan Sharp! We're so glad
that so many people loved it. We carefully considered your [b]feedback[/b] and suggestions and implemented an [b]update[/b] as quickly as possible. With that being said, here is a quick update and what's changed:

- Additional ambient lights and a post-process added in the museum room to make it [b]lighter[/b] than before.
- A post-process lighting effect added on every [b]inspectable item[/b]. We've noticed you had trouble reading some of the notes around the house, so we've added a helping post-process which will automatically enlighten everything during inspection.
- Increased [b]"bang" sound[/b] volume in private room, fixed an animation when opening the [b]padlock[/b], several tweaks made in the [b]storage room[/b].
- Fade out the volume of intense music during the [b]stairs scene[/b], additional [b]hint[/b] added in the [b]museum room[/b] and a [b]sound notifier[/b] added near the end of the demo.
- Added [b]3 UI elements[/b] on the screen for [b]journal, inventory & flashlight[/b]. We've noticed some players who did not read the hint "Press F for Flashlight" and did not know there was a flashlight in-game. The icons are at the bottom of the screen and will vanish the moment you use that particular action.
- Phone sound timer [b]tweaked and optimized[/b] even more.
- [b]New texture and geometry[/b] added for the child in the Intro Cinematic to fix particular normals and shadows.

[b]Thank you all[/b] for your contribution! We'll continue to work on another update and will notify you when it is available. Like we said, [b]your opinion matters[/b]!

notes.title: Meet the Developers of Alan Sharp!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Alan Sharp Demo Gameplay Done! Let's do this together![/b][/h1]

You have played the [b]Alan Sharp Demo[/b], watched a gameplay or you're just [i]curious[/i] about the game itself? Feel free to join us in this[b] Q&A Discussion[/b] where we would gladly answer any of your questions.

Join us on our [b]Discord Channel[/b]: https://discord.gg/hkyT2nq

[h2][b]Let's make the best horror experience together![/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] An [b]idea[/b] suddenly popped up? Feel free to share it with us! We'll gladly consider it. The final goal is to create the ultimate horror experience for all fans!
[*] You have a [b]suggestion[/b] for a particular level, event, character, game mechanic? Don't be shy... open up to us and we'll find a solution together which might end up in the full game!
[*] An interesting addition to the overall [b]storyline[/b] flashed into your mind? Share it with us! Let's look it up and see how it will fit.
[*] You have a suggestion for a new [b]game mechanic[/b] or an improvement for the already implemented ones? Feel free to contact us and see if it can be done!
[*] There was a [b]bug[/b] you've noticed? Let's note it and get it done as it should be.
[*] Any kind of  [b]Questions[/b] about the game itself, the demo, the storyline, the characters, the gameplay? Throw it at us! We'll gladly do our best to answer it!
[/list]
